formats.name: Liberty Table
formats.about: A small table of up to five people who meet in person, at a cafe or a restaurant, to talk about the election and what is at stake.

formats.name: Watch party
formats.about: People who meet in person to watch a big night together, like a debate or the results coming in.

formats.name: Registration party
formats.about: People who meet in person and help each other get registered to vote before the deadline.

formats.name: Vote together
formats.about: People who meet up and go to the polls together, on election day or for early voting.

front.lead: Liberty has enemies. They are organized. Now so are we.
front.q: How will you fight for liberty?

answers.line: This is where the plan gets made. Make your free account and argue it out with the others.
Gatherings near you are listed here. Make your free account and take a seat at one.
Host a small gathering and I send people to it. Make your free account to post it.

count.one: You're the first to choose this.

front.kept: Your answer is kept on your account.
front.noscript: Sign in to answer and keep your answer on your account.

second.q: Which enemy will you fight first?
